info.title: Straight Up Tax API
info.description:
HTTP API for the Straight Up Tax app. This document covers the **full api-service surface** served by the standalone API process (see route manifest).

**Versioning**

- Paths are unversioned under `/api/*`. Clients send `x-app-version` (or `appVersion` query) to `GET /api/handshake`, which returns numeric `apiContract` and `status` (`ok` | `deprecated` | `blocked`).
- Incompatible request/response shape changes bump `apiContract`; URL prefixes like `/api/v2` are reserved for a future deliberate cutover.

**Authentication** (mirrors the app)

Product auth is **email OTP** (not email/password):

1. Send a code: `POST /api/auth/email-otp/send-verification-otp` with `{ "email", "type": "sign-in" }`.
2. Sign in: `POST /api/auth/sign-in/email-otp` with `{ "email", "otp" }`. New emails are registered on success.
3. Call protected routes with either:
   - **Bearer (preferred for Try it / Postman / curl):** `Authorization: Bearer <token>` where `token` comes from the OTP sign-in / session payload (native app path via Better Auth bearer plugin).
   - **Cookie (web):** session cookie `better-auth.session_token` when the client stores cookies.
4. Inspect session: `GET /api/auth/get-session`.
5. Sign out: `POST /api/auth/sign-out`.

Sign-in may be disabled in some environments. Staging `/docs` Cloudflare Access is **separate** from API session auth — Access only gates the docs UI.

**Trying calls**

Pick a server above, authenticate, then call any authed operation. Prefer Bearer for non-browser clients.

post.description: Sends a one-time code to the email address. Use type `sign-in` for the product login flow. New users are created on successful OTP verification (no separate sign-up endpoint). On local/staging the code is also logged by the api process when email delivery is not configured.

403.description: Sign-in is not available in this environment

post.description: Verifies the email OTP and creates a Better Auth session. Use the returned token as a Bearer token for API calls; browser clients can use the session cookie. If the email is not registered yet, Better Auth creates the account as part of this call.

403.description: Sign-in is not available in this environment

post.description: Invalidates the current Better Auth session and clears its session cookie.

get.description: Returns the current Better Auth session and user, or null when anonymous.

post.description: Verifies a JWT against this API's JWKS endpoint (/api/auth/jwks). Does not validate Better Auth session tokens from OTP sign-in; use those as Bearer tokens on authenticated routes instead.

get.description: Checks whether an app version is compatible with the current API contract. Supply the version with the x-app-version header or appVersion query parameter; when omitted, the current server app version is used.
Returns the public profile and application state for the authenticated user. Both values can be null when the corresponding records have not been created.

patch.description: Updates the supplied public profile fields and onboarding state for the authenticated user. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

get.summary: Check whether a username is available
get.description: Checks whether a username is available to the authenticated user. A username already assigned to that same user is reported as available.

get.summary: Get business setup settings for the current user
get.description: Returns the authenticated user’s business setup and vehicle claim settings. Unconfigured fields are returned as null.

patch.summary: Update business setup settings for the current user
patch.description: Creates or replaces the authenticated user’s business setup settings. A successful update also marks onboarding as complete.

get.summary: List notifications for the current user
get.description: Returns recent notifications owned by the authenticated user. Use pageSize to control the maximum number of items, which defaults to 50.

items.body: Your quarterly submission is being processed.

patch.description: Updates a notification owned by the authenticated user. The response item is null when no matching notification exists.

put.description: Registers a device for the authenticated user or updates the existing device with the same id. Push configuration and client version metadata are stored for notifications and diagnostics.

post.description: Queues an HMRC quarterly submission for the authenticated user and returns its background job id. quarterId is required by the handler, while taxYearStart defaults to the current tax year when omitted.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user’s merchant categorisation rules.

post.description: Creates a merchant categorisation rule, or updates the matching merchant rule when upsert is true.

patch.description: Updates the supplied fields of an authenticated user’s categorisation rule.

delete.description: Deletes the rule identified by id, or clears all categorisation rules when id is omitted.

Returns the authenticated user’s mileage entries and calculated claim values. Pass limit and offset to load a page.

delete.description: Deletes a mileage entry owned by the authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates an entire series or splits it from a given date for this-and-future changes.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user’s totals, categories, blockers, and existing submission for a quarter.
